voice.name: Test Voice
voice.basis: the channel's established narrator (same id as Dead Spider and Cyborg Cockroach); confirmed with creative_list_voices on 2026-10-29

prompt: [curious, intense, conversational] If this fungus gets inside an ANT — it can turn it into a ZOMBIE. [brisk, explaining] You see, it spreads through the ant's body — and starts controlling its MUSCLES. Then it forces the ant to CLIMB a plant — and bite down so hard it can't let GO. [darker, intense] The ant DIES — but the fungus is just getting STARTED. [building] Because over the next few days, a giant stalk grows straight out of its HEAD. And when it finally opens — it releases spores onto the ants BELOW. [quieter, eerie] And beneath that one leaf — there could be dozens more ants that died the exact same way.
prompt_note: The locked words, verbatim. The script's ellipses were given to the model as em-dash beats so it would not pause at every ellipsis (the brief: continuous and urgent); the bracket tags direct delivery and are not spoken.
generated_once: One run of two variations (the connector default), 2 x 618.9 credits. No regeneration.

asr.zipformer_en: spellings only: zomby, spoors on to

takes.why_not: zipformer hears bungus / sombi / giant's / aunt: softer articulation of fungus and zombie

edits: Speech untouched (no splice inside a word, no time-stretch, no pitch change). Twelve long silent gaps between phrases shortened (removed audio below -45 dBFS, 10 ms crossfades): sentence ends to 0.28 s, dash beats to 0.24 s, 'DIES…' kept at 0.34 s, 'leaf…' 0.30 s; 1.43 s removed in total (see FGW_Zombie_Ant_V1_words.json). Mix: gentle compressor and a look-ahead limiter on the voice.

word_timing.master: local sherpa-onnx Zipformer token timestamps, snapped to measured pause onsets (tools/align_zipformer.py)
word_timing.cross_reference: ElevenLabs Scribe (takes/t1_aaJ0_scribe.json): it returns the prompt's text and lags up to ~0.4 s, so it is not the master

listening: Not listened to in real time: this environment has no audio playback. Selection by two ASR models, pause measurement and level.
